items.source: base class for query builders. The different implementations of Query should derive from this class and then offer a constructor that takes their builder as argument and passes this on to the super class.
items.translation: 查询构建器的基类。不同的 Query 实现类应继承自该类，并提供一个接受其构建器作为参数的构造函数，并将该构建器传递给父类。

items.source: Set Ids with routing values for a multi-get request run with this query.
items.translation: 为使用此查询的多获取请求运行设置具有路由值的 ID。

items.source: Set Ids with routing values for a multi-get request run with this query. Not used in any other searches.
items.translation: 为多获取请求运行此查询时，设置带有路由值的 ID。在其他搜索中不使用。

items.source: idsWithRouting - list of id values, must not be null
items.translation: idsWithRouting - ID 值列表，不得为 null
